compiler.arguments: [--bundle ROOT] source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]

evaluator.budget_unit: one explicit source-machine step; a terminal return consumes no further budget

wasm.parameters: live enum ordinals only; erased parameters omitted

output_policy: The compiler opens the requested output only after complete checking and bounded emission; semantic failure and exhaustion leave existing output untouched. File-write failures are HostFailure and may leave an incomplete file, never a Built result. Callers must use the exit status, not file presence, as evidence of a fresh artifact.
external_argument_domain: Each live evaluator ordinal must designate a nullary constructor of its declared type; eval-cli reports HostFailure structured-argument for fielded constructor ordinals. The Node adapter accepts only enum-signatured host calls: live arity and profile-wide 0..255 are checked, while declared signature and per-type domain remain caller preconditions.
later_milestones: broader recursion beyond first-parameter field descent

structural_recursion.rule: First checked self-call argument must be a Reference to a strict field descendant of parameter 0; matches propagate descendant levels.
structural_recursion.forward_and_mutual_calls: Unchanged; live forward calls are Invalid check forward-live-call.

structural_terms.patterns: flat constructors with plain or + field binders
structural_terms.observation: Live-field projection, declaration order; erased fields omitted

fields_wasm.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
fields_wasm.budgets: Same defaults and maximum overrides as compiler; profile selection is explicit.
fields_wasm.enum_entry_unchanged: src/compile-cli.bend calls emit, which selects Enum{} and retains enum_profile rejection.
fields_wasm.enum_only_book_bytes: Identical to knot-enum-1; 25 frozen module hashes checked in both compiler lanes.

representation.fielded_type: i32 address of [tag][live fields in declaration order], one 4-byte word each
representation.zero_address: Valid cell address, not a null sentinel

arena.guard: unsigned size > 65536 - bump; only unreachable in the profile
arena.allocation: Arguments saved before allocation; stores after bounded pointer advance
arena.lifetime: Instance lifetime; immutable initialized cells; no free, reset, growth or reclamation

fields_wasm.exports: All original functions, unchanged indices; allocator appended and unexported; no memory or global exports.
fields_wasm.host_precondition: Checked Knot module of selected profile; invoke only enum-only live parameter/result signatures with valid per-type ordinals. Structured functions are for compiled callers. Adapter cannot enforce signature provenance.

host_outcomes.node_startup_failure: Outside adapter classification; not a successful execution

fields_wasm.proof_boundary: Five checked capability/representation/erasure helper laws, not general compiler or memory refinement.

module_loading.legacy_commands: Existing single-file forms keep their arguments, limits and exit codes. Their diagnostics change where the module rules apply: let and arm binders named like an earlier constructor report Invalid check constructor-pattern-binder (let binders were accepted, arm binders Unsupported check variable-pattern); a field binder named like a later constructor is accepted (was Invalid); the declaration-order binder walk is bounded at 65536 work steps (Exhausted check); a result type longer than one name reports Unsupported parse result-type (was Invalid parse function-result); a spaced '- >' arrow reports Invalid parse function-result (was accepted); parent-relative imports report Unsupported parse import (was Invalid parse declaration-name); '&' or '|' after a parameter or field type reports Unsupported parse parameter-type (was Invalid parse argument-separator), as an application or arrow there already did; an application, arrow, '&' or '|' after a typed-let type reports Unsupported parse binding-type (was Invalid parse expected-=); an unbound dotted let, typed-let or field binder reports Invalid check dotted-binder (was accepted).
module_loading.legacy_commands_decision: Accepted by the coordinator on 2026-09-28: each single-file change moves Knot toward the seed's verdict and is pinned by seed-derived fixtures (tests/compiler-modules/REVIEW-ROUND-5.md#single-file-deltas; the dotted-binder row in REVIEW-ROUND-6.md).
module_loading.bundle: Explicit frozen local directory standing in for BEND_LIB; no network or named-package resolution.
module_loading.identity: Lexically normalized filesystem path after a host query checks exact directory-entry spelling and no symlink components; ambiguous paths report Unsupported load path-identity. Entry and bundle roots are queried before normalization. A relative entry, bundle root or import target that still climbs above the working directory after normalization has no canonical spelling and reports Unsupported load path-identity; the working directory itself (--bundle .) contains every relative path. A bundle root that normalizes to the root directory reports Unsupported load root-bundle, since the seed's prefix for it contains nothing. As in the seed, one empty segment after a leading ./ or hash head (.//x.bend, 0x<hash>//x.bend) names the single-slash module; any other empty segment is Invalid load import-path.
module_loading.output: compile --bundle opens the output only after loading. A symlinked, case-inexact or climbing output reports HostFailure arguments output-path; an output naming the entry, a loaded module or the Base path (equal on one basis, or an absolute spelling ending with the relative one) reports HostFailure arguments source-is-output.
module_loading.namespaces: Local modules relative to entry directory; bundle modules relative to bundle root; aliases are file-local.
module_loading.declaration_order: Dependency-first ordered stream; all user definitions checked, including unused definitions; completed paths are loaded once and active back edges rejected.

base.pin: Runtime Bend SHA-256 over bounded ASCII input, before inventory construction.
base.registration: Book-global from first import event, with distinct type/function and constructor namespaces. Both bare and qualified user declarations, and the later Base inventory, reject same-category collisions.
base.slice: Transitive dependencies of every user declaration; selected Base source is parsed and checked in the combined book.
base.trust_inventory: After combined checking, audit records BasePin, Module paths, BaseChecked names and exact BaseUnchecked complement.
base.unsupported: Reachable features outside the language yield specific Unsupported reasons; no unchecked acceptance or substitute prelude.

limits.base_slice: Finite dependency work bound derived from parser depth.

module_loading.proof_boundary: Path, scope, transition, selection and digest helper laws; not whole-graph confluence, SHA-256 refinement or compiler correctness.
module_loading.foreign_effects: Existing IO/file effects plus src/path-host.bend::inspect, a minimal native/Bun filesystem identity query. It observes component spelling and symlinks only; classification stays in Bend. No environment lookup or network is added.
module_loading.wasm_profile: Existing enum emitter; importing a book adds no fielded or recursive Wasm capability.
